author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Seventy-Nine! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Are you constantly beset by dreams of a neon-laser future of fantasy warriors in an apocalyptic hellscape? Miss Thundarr? Miss Heavy Metal? Miss Masters of the Universe? Cyber-Savage the game of Laser Sorcery might be for you. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE:  https://www.wargamevault.com//product/554168/cyber-savage-the-laser-sorcery-miniatures-game?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 079 - Cyber-Savage by Benjamin and Jared McClure
